Email account compromise: S - Mail, hacking Unknown. Incident date coded as discovery Nov 24, 2025 because no start date is given; the law-firm page says the mailbox 'may have been accessible for nearly a year' before discovery, which if confirmed would put the start in early 2025 and dbir_year 2026. NAICS 6212 in issue is dentists; this is a facial plastic surgery practice -> 621111. Count not given. Discovery internal Unknown (suspicious activity detected). Employee count Unknown.

summary: Facial Surgery Group, PC detected suspicious activity in an employee email account on November 24, 2025 and secured it. A forensic investigation completed February 2, 2026 found potential unauthorized access to patient information, including medical record numbers, Medicaid numbers, diagnosis and treatment details, dates of birth and insurance group numbers. A data mining review finished September 9, 2026 and letters were sent October 16, 2026. The mailbox may have been accessible for nearly a year before discovery.
